issues.description: audio_format derivation breaks for sample rates not in STTAudioFormat literal
issues.detail: In STTv2.__init__, audio_format is built via f'pcm_{sample_rate}' and cast to STTAudioFormat. The docstring says 8kHz-48kHz are supported, but only six discrete rates are valid (8000, 16000, 22050, 24000, 44100, 48000). Passing e.g. sample_rate=32000 silently produces 'pcm_32000', sent to the API which will reject it. Validate sample_rate against STTAudioFormat values and raise a clear error.

issues.description: Reconnect path may lose connection state and drop the reconnect event
issues.detail: The outer while-loop in _run breaks unconditionally if wait_reconnect_task not in done, but the reconnect mechanism is never actually triggered anywhere (no _reconnect_event.set() call). Either remove the dead reconnect machinery or wire it to actual reconnect conditions (e.g., transient ws closures). As written, any unexpected close raises and aborts the stream rather than reconnecting like other plugins do.

issues.description: APIConnectionError raised from background recv_task is swallowed
issues.detail: _process_stream_event raises APIConnectionError on auth/quota/etc errors, but it is called inside recv_task's try/except that does logger.exception(...) and continues the loop. The raised error never propagates to the gather, so fatal errors like auth_error or quota_exceeded are logged and the stream silently keeps running with a broken session. Re-raise or break out of the recv loop for fatal error types.

issues.description: Range constraints documented but not validated
issues.detail: The docstring states vad_silence_threshold_secs must be 0.3-3.0, vad_threshold 0.1-0.9, min_speech/silence_duration_ms 50-2000, but no validation is performed. Out-of-range values are silently forwarded as query params, producing opaque server errors. Add explicit bounds checks in __init__ to fail fast with clear messages.

In the finally block, tasks_group.cancel() is called and then tasks_group.exception() is invoked unconditionally. If the gather hasn't completed (still cancelling), calling .exception() raises asyncio.InvalidStateError. The comment says 'retrieve exception to prevent logging' but the call should be guarded by tasks_group.done() or wrapped in try/except.

issues.description: STTModels Literal has trailing comma yielding awkward single-element type
issues.detail: STTModels = Literal['scribe_v2_realtime',] works but the trailing comma is unusual styling. More importantly, since the codebase supports only one model id, accepting a free-form STTModels argument signals extensibility that doesn't exist; consider clarifying or hardcoding until additional models land.

review.summary: New ElevenLabs Scribe v2 streaming STT plugin follows the established Deepgram/Cartesia plugin shape but has several latent correctness issues. The most significant is silent acceptance of sample rates outside the supported audio format set, which produces a malformed query param. Reconnect/error handling has gaps: APIConnectionError raised inside recv_task is swallowed by the surrounding try/except, the reconnect_event machinery is wired but never triggered, and tasks_group.exception() can raise. Range validation documented in the docstring is not enforced. Tests are absent, which the author flagged; given the precedent that's acceptable but the above runtime issues should be addressed first.
